editorial.meta_description: Prepare for the NetApp NCIE SAN and Hybrid Cloud examination by reviewing format details, exactly 65 questions, passing score, and study guidance.
editorial.overview: The NCIE NetApp Certified Implementation Engineer: SAN/Hybrid Cloud examination evaluates technical skills across six core domains including ONTAP Data Management and enterprise storage architectures. Certified officially by NetApp, this current linear test consists of exactly 65 multiple choice and multiple response questions delivered securely through Pearson VUE test centers.
editorial.who_should_take: Storage implementation engineers, systems administrators, and enterprise architects who routinely deploy, configure, and manage enterprise storage environments utilizing NetApp ONTAP platforms alongside various cloud integrations.
editorial.preparation_strategy: Review all available ONTAP study documentation, official references, and latest release notes carefully before your exam date. Practice cluster administration routines extensively using available administration tools and interfaces. Focus your full review on storage virtualization, replication workflows, high-availability pairs, and general infrastructure configurations to ensure complete readiness.

domain_guidance.summary: Covers core ONTAP Data Management principles, focusing heavily on operational practices, system configuration, software upgrade procedures, and routine cluster administration tasks handled efficiently through system interfaces and command-line tools.

This domain focuses on storage architecture and design principles within complex enterprise environments, addressing node configurations, highly available pairs, and the underlying disk structures alongside local tier designs.

This domain involves detailed SAN and NAS configuration tasks, managing client protocols, path failover mechanics, storage virtualization structures, flexible volumes, qtrees, individual files, and LUN provisioning procedures across enterprise storage arrays.

This domain specifically addresses core data protection operations and SnapVault mechanisms, examining replication workflows, secure backup targets, recovery procedures, and storage efficiency features built directly into modern ONTAP clusters.

This section explores cloud integration strategies across supported cloud platforms, utilizing object storage repositories and external data destinations to effectively connect local enterprise storage environments with cloud architectures.

This final domain encompasses performance monitoring and troubleshooting methodologies, utilizing diagnostic data, configuration advisory reports, and hardware configuration reviews to successfully resolve operational issues within deployed NetApp systems.

editorial.exam_day_guidance: Arrive at the Pearson VUE testing center with valid identification. Read each question carefully before answering, managing your time across all 65 items on the linear exam.

faq.question_title: How many questions are on the exam?
faq.answer_text: The certification exam contains a total of exactly 65 questions presented in a linear format using multiple choice and multiple response question types for all candidates.
The passing score uses a scaled model where the passing score is set at 60, reflecting approximately 70% passing performance for most candidates taking this specific test.

faq.question_title: How much does the exam cost?
faq.answer_text: The price for registering and taking the exam is 250.0 USD, which is payable directly when scheduling your test appointment through the Pearson VUE platform.

faq.question_title: How long is the certification valid?
faq.answer_text: The earned certification remains valid for a total period of 2 years, after which formal renewal is required to maintain your active credential status with NetApp.

methodology.summary: This page was constructed using official NetApp study documentation, source materials, and verified hard facts regarding exam logistics, domain weightings, and structural criteria.
